farmacovigilancia.title: Pharmacovigilance
farmacovigilancia.subtitle: Your report helps us monitor the safety of our products. Notify any suspected adverse reaction related to a GABAME product.
farmacovigilancia.whatText: Any unwanted or unexpected effect you suspect may be related to the use of one of our products, even if you are not sure about the connection.
